source.name: Football Shirt Culture, 'Club Brugge 2026-27 Home Kit by Castore Revealed'
source.quote: the Castore logo and Betsson sport shirt sponsor branding are applied in white
source.note: Club's own site (archived footer, July 2026) lists betsson.sport and Castore as the only two Main Partners: https://web.archive.org/web/20260704011830/https://www.clubbrugge.be/en/club-brugge-jobs-partners

source.name: Footy Headlines, 'Club Brugge 26-27 Home Kit Released'
source.quote: This is the Club Brugge KV 2026-27 home shirt, made by Castore.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Same article: kit priced at 90 euros (replica) or 120 euros (pro), debuted during the Champions' Play-offs match against AA Gent.

summary: betsson.sport on the front, Castore as kit maker. Kit photos confirm no back, sleeve or shorts sponsor: the rear neckline carries only the club motto 'No Sweat No Glory', the sleeves are plain, and the shorts and socks carry only the club crest, Castore mark and 'FCB'.
